$comment: Bundled agent launch definitions. Agent launch is DATA, not code.
Override or extend these by creating ~/.couchmode/agents.json with the same shape;
entries there are merged over these defaults, keyed by agent name.
Couchmode never handles credentials. Each agent CLI uses the login it already has.
'loginHint' is the command Couchmode prints in the terminal when an agent reports
that it is not authenticated. It is never sent to the TV or phone clients.
'preferredModes' is a priority list of ACP session mode ids. Approving tool calls
from the couch is the whole point of Couchmode, so on startup it switches the
session to the first of these the agent actually offers - agents that default to
deciding permissions themselves would otherwise never ask. Override with --mode.
